violations.text: The soap and paper towel is lacking at front hand-washing sink. PIC placed soap and paper towel near handwashing sink at time of inspection. HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap and be provided with: -Individual, disposable towels; -A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; -A heated-air hand drying device Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. PIC moved can opener to dishwashing area to be washed, rinised and cleaned at time of inspection. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
Observed water from handwashing sink splashing on prep table during prep. Handwashing sink shall have a splash guard to prevent contamination during food prep. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (mixer was observed with) an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. Employee cleaned, and sanitized nonfood contact surfaces of mixer at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The 3-bay sink faucet is unable to reach all bays of the sink. Establishment is to install an additional faucet to 3-bay sink. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the storage hand sink area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026

Inadequate lighting was observed in the walk-in freezer. 6-303.11 Intensity. The light intensity shall be: -At least 108 lux (10 foot candles) at 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry FOOD storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning; -At least 540 lux (50 foot candles) at a surface where a FOOD EMPLOYEE is working with FOOD or working with UTENSILS or EQUIPMENT such as knives, slicers, grinders, or saws where EMPLOYEE safety is a factor. -Establishment shall replace bulbs with a brighter one. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Wood is used in the construction of the hand sink in the upstairs service area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Per PIC, the base of hand sink will be replaced with stainless steel. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The dishwasher located in the downstairs bar area was not in good repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. Per PIC, service has been called. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026
The 3-bay sink faucet is unable to reach all bays of the sink. Establishment is to install an additional faucet to 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The walls in the upstairs dry storage area, and basement storage area were observed with holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Establishment is to repair walls. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the storage hand sink area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2026
